_otherbali_note: REFERENCE SHAPE ONLY — not approved markup. Actual venue JSON-LD is governed by .agents/skills/otherbali-schema-markup/SKILL.md and emitted by app/places/[slug]/page.tsx, where every field passes a gate and a missing value omits the key. Upstream's aggregateRating and review blocks have been REMOVED and must not be restored: guardrail #2 forbids republishing Google ratings or review-derived claims, and we hold no first-party rating, so any value here would be either scraped or invented. Strip this key before using the shape.
name: VENUE_NAME
image: MEDIA_ASSET_URL — via venuePhotoUrlForDisplay, never a raw column
description: VENUE_DESCRIPTION — from the venue record, evidence-backed

address._gate: streetAddress only via publishableStreetAddress — venues.full_address mostly holds an area note and has published an operator working note before

geo._gate: both present and finite, or omit the whole geo object

openingHoursSpecification._gate: buildOpeningHoursSpec(opening_hours_json) — the only form that can carry two services in one day; never hand-write from opening_hours text
